characters:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game character-material atlas for Jelly Squish.
Create ONE 1536x1024 image with a precise 3-column by 2-row grid, each cell 512x512. Glossy hand-painted casual puzzle game jelly, rounded-square gelatin with rich translucent depth, subtle internal bubbles, white specular shine upper left, crisp soft dark outline, luminous lower rim. Straight front/top-down game view, no perspective, no legs or arms.
COLUMNS are three NEW jelly characters: LEFT emerald-mint liquid slime; CENTER warm golden-amber honey jelly; RIGHT bright rose-pink elastic candy jelly. Keep these colors unmistakably different.
TOP ROW: three FACELESS BODY sprites, one in each column's color. Absolutely no eyes, mouth or face in the top row. Each body occupies local x=30..482 and y=30..482 with rounded corners. These are deformable materials; renderer adds eyes.
BOTTOM ROW: matching full mascots in the exact same respective mint, amber, rose colors, each a rounded-square cute jelly with big shining dark eyes and white rims, pink cheeks, a tiny open smile. Each centered with 40px padding.
Background uniformly very dark plum #20152b with only subtle matching halos around bodies. All sprites separated and contained in their cells, exact regular 3x2 grid, no text, no labels, no dividers, no shadows crossing cells. This is a game sprite atlas, not a concept scene.
